title: Ocean wave normals from a directional wave spectrum
purpose: Generate tileable maps of a water surface: a sum of directional sine waves with whole-number wave vectors drawn from a wind-sea spectrum, Gerstner-style crest sharpening and whitecap foam where crests compress. The normal map is the main output for water shaders; calm swell to storm presets.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python ocean_wave_normals.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: peak_waves
parameters.meaning: Cycles of the dominant wavelength across the tile.

parameters.name: wind_angle
parameters.meaning: Direction the waves travel, in turns from the +U axis.

parameters.name: spread
parameters.meaning: Directional spreading: 0 long parallel crests, 1 waves from every direction.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.meaning: Weight of short waves and ripples against the peak band.

parameters.name: choppiness
parameters.meaning: Sideways crest sharpening, 0 smooth sines to 1 nearly breaking.

parameters.name: foam
parameters.meaning: Whitecap foam on the most compressed crests.

parameters.name: relief
parameters.meaning: Strength of the normal map relief.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Open sea: a moderate wind sea with sharpened crests and a little foam.

presets.name: calm_swell
presets.description: Long parallel swell with smooth crests and no foam.

presets.name: choppy_wind
presets.description: Short, steep wind chop from many directions with whitecaps.

presets.name: stormy
presets.description: Heavy grey-green storm sea, near-breaking crests streaked with foam.

presets.name: lake_ripples
presets.description: Small isotropic ripples on a brown-green lake.

limits: One still frame of a stylized spectrum, not an ocean simulation: there is no dispersion relation, time animation or FFT, and the spectrum shape is a log-normal band with cosine spreading rather than a measured model such as JONSWAP. Choppiness resamples the height once at the displaced position, an approximation of Gerstner waves that holds while crests do not fold. Every wave repeats across the tile, so long views show the repeat; blend two scales of the tile in the shader to hide it. Foam is placed from crest compression and noise, not from breaking physics, and the occlusion map is a mild stand-in.
technique_references: Sum of sine waves with integer wave vectors for exact tiling
Directional spectrum: log-normal band times cosine-power spreading
Gumbel top-k weighted sampling of wave components
Separable evaluation by the sine addition formula
Gerstner horizontal displacement and its Jacobian for crest sharpening and foam
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
